description: A React component that provides a button to open a modal dialog for searching users by email and adding them to a team. It manages state for modal visibility, email input, search results, and loading indicators, and interacts with an API to perform searches and handle user addition.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Performs an email-based user search using the external API, updating search results or handling errors.

methods.name: handleAddToTeam
methods.description: Handles adding a user to the team, currently simulated with an alert; intended to call a backend API in the future.
